SEEKING: TWO LEADS

Male Actor — Late 20s/Early 30s - Clean-shaven / willing to shave

Female Actor — Mid-to-Late 20s

SHOOT: TBC — Early November

LOCATION: Brixton, London

PAY: EXPENSES ONLY

See attached casting sheets for further character information.

If interested, please contact caseyreeseevans2003@yahoo.com with a headshot and any supporting materials.

Otherwise, please comment with a Spotlight link or DM if required.

items.text:
👑 CZAS NA TWOJĄ KORONĘ! 👑

Masz w sobie charyzmę, odwagę i lubisz być w centrum uwagi? A może zawsze marzyłaś o tym, żeby przeżyć prawdziwą przygodę i stanąć przed publicznością jako kandydatka do tytułu Miss? ✨

Otwieramy nabór kandydatek do wyjątkowego konkursu piękności! 💎

To będzie wieczór pełen blasku, emocji, elegancji i zdrowej rywalizacji. Każda uczestniczka będzie miała okazję zaprezentować swoją osobowość, styl i pewność siebie. 🔥

🏆 NA ZWYCIĘŻCZYNIĘ CZEKA:

💰 30 000 zł
🇪🇸 7-dniowy wyjazd do Hiszpanii
👑 prestiżowy tytuł Miss
📸 wyjątkowa oprawa wydarzenia
✨ niezapomniane doświadczenie

Kogo szukamy?

🔸 kobiet, które ukończyły 18 lat
🔸 pewnych siebie i komunikatywnych
🔸 zadbanych i swobodnie czujących się przed kamerą
🔸 gotowych na udział w wydarzeniu, próbach i przygotowaniach
🔸 otwartych na sesje zdjęciowe i występy przed publicznością
🔸 z ciekawą osobowością i własnym stylem

Doświadczenie w modelingu nie jest konieczne — chcemy dać szansę również osobom, które nigdy wcześniej nie brały udziału w takim konkursie. ❤️

Jeżeli czujesz, że korona może być właśnie dla Ciebie, nie czekaj! 👑

📩 Zgłoszenia przyjmujemy w wiadomości prywatnej.
Napisz kilka słów o sobie i dowiedz się, co zrobić, aby wziąć udział.

30 000 zł + Hiszpania + korona.
Może tej historii właśnie brakuje… Ciebie. 👑✨

DWA NOWE CASTINGI! Poszukujemy dwóch modelek

CASTING 1: POSZUKUJEMY MODELKI - 1 400 ZŁ BRUTTO ZA DZIEŃ ZDJĘCIOWY 

Organizujemy sesję video, podczas której będziemy produkować mówione rolki / Tik-Toki dla naszego klienta – firmy z branży energetycznej.  W tym celu poszukujemy modelki. Planujemy jednodniowy plan zdjęciowy w studio i w plenerze w Krakowie w pierwszej połowie października. 
  
Wynagrodzenie za udział w sesji: 1 400 zł brutto 
Wymagania dla modelki:
Wiek: 20 - 40 lat
Wzrost: 160 - 180 (modelka) 
Sylwetka: Szczupła / Normalna (modelka) 
Wygląd: Atrakcyjna 

Pole wykorzystania wizerunku: Jedynie internet. Nie wymagamy podpisania jakiejkolwiek umowy związane z udzieleniem wizerunku na wyłączność.

Prosimy o przesyłanie:
* Aktualnych zdjęć sylwetki i portfolio
* próbek materiałów mówionych video
* adresu mailowego
* numer telefonu i adresu mailowego
* Miasta, z którego dojedziesz na sesję

CASTING 2: POSZUKUJEMY MODELKI - 1 100 ZŁ BRUTTO ZA DZIEŃ ZDJĘCIOWY
Organizujemy sesję video, podczas której będziemy produkować mówione rolki / Tik-Toki dla naszego klienta – marki zajmującej się pozyskiwaniem leadów w mediach społecznościowych. W tym celu poszukujemy modelk atrakcyjnej modelki. Planujemy jednodniowy plan zdjęciowy w studio w Krakowie w pierwszej połowie października. 

Wynagrodzenie: 1 100 zł brutto + zwrot kosztów podróży
Wymagania:
Wiek: 20 - 40 lat
Wzrost: 160 - 180 (modelka) 
Wygląd: Poszukujemy atrakcyjnej modelki, która ma świadomość swojego wyglądu. W studio będziemy aranżować scenografią plażę, więc część z rolek będzie nagrywana w stroju kąpielowym. 

Prosimy o przesyłanie:
* Aktualnych zdjęć sylwetki (strój kąpielowy) i portfolio
* próbek materiałów mówionych video
* adresu mailowego
* numer telefonu i adresu mailowego
* Miasta, z którego dojedziesz na sesję

Jak aplikować? Prosimy o DM na Instagramie z informacją na który casting aplikujesz 
https://www.instagram.com/dziekanowsky
lub ewentualnie komentarz poniżej.

# **CASTING CALL – CHILD ACTOR | VANCOUVER, BC 🎬**

We’re currently casting the role of **Viktor** for *Hollyville*, an independent mystery/horror short film shooting in Vancouver this October.

**VIKTOR**
Boy, **5–10 years old**, all ethnicities. Viktor is a quiet, sensitive, and observant 6-year-old who has recently lost his parents. He clings closely to his older brother, Arden, as they find themselves pulled into the strange and increasingly frightening world of Hollyville.

📍 **Location:** Vancouver, BC
🎥 **Shoot Dates:** October 2–4
🎭 **Non-union / Volunteer**
🍴 Food provided on set
🎞 IMDb credit + footage provided

We’re a passionate independent filmmaking team and would love to connect with young performers interested in being part of the project.

To submit, please send a **headshot/photo, résumé, and demo reel if available** to:

📧 **info@rollthedieproductions.com**

**Submission Deadline: Sep 5, 2026**

🎬 CASTING CALL: ACTRESS FOR AN UNUSUAL ROLE 😂
Looking for a female actress for a short-term role.

The role involves helping me manage my Hinge account and, more importantly, helping me communicate with the ladies in a way that I apparently need professional assistance with. 📱💘

Think of it as method acting meets dating app management.

🎭 What I’m looking for:

• Female actress, ideally comfortable with improvisation

• Naturally charismatic and good at conversation

• Able to convincingly play the role of my highly competent dating assistant

👨 About the “client”:

Early 30s, athletic, reasonably intelligent, and somehow at the point in life where outsourcing his Hinge conversations seems like a perfectly reasonable idea.

I can provide more details about the role privately, including what exactly you’d be getting yourself into. 😌

If this sounds like the kind of weird little acting gig you’d actually enjoy, drop a comment!

🎬 Auditions may consist primarily of proving you’re funnier than me.

NEW STUDENTS WELCOME - Find Your Voice at Majestic Academy of Performing Arts!

Finding your voice means something different to everyone. 🎭🎶

For some, it might mean hitting that big note, stepping into a character for the first time, or taking centre stage in a show. But it’s also about having the confidence to be heard, share ideas, express yourself and simply be YOU. 🌟

At Majestic Academy of Performing Arts in Chester,
we provide a fun, welcoming and supportive environment where children and young people can build confidence, explore their creativity and discover what they’re capable of.

💫 Find your confidence.
🎭 Find your creativity.
🎤 Find your voice.

#MajesticAcademy #Chester #PerformingArts #ActingSchool #DanceSchool

Hello! My name is Adriana Diaz, a film student at Florida State. I am currently a senior and working on my final film in my undergraduate career.  I am in search of young, Hispanic actresses (preferably Cuban but not required).

The film is titled Stalled and follows: 
Dolorita, a young Cuban woman struggling with OCD, descends into a liminal space of endless bathroom stalls where she encounters various future versions of herself, each troubled by compulsions and lack of control. Dolorita is forced to confront the compulsions that have plagued her for years. Is escape possible or will she continue to allow her mind to consume her?

Filming takes place November 5-8. We are searching for actresses interested in playing Dolorita mainly but open to those interested to other roles. 

We are a student production, meaning it is an unpaid opportunity. We are filming in Tallahassee, FL. Travel expenses and accommodations covered for non-local actors. Attached is the casting call and below is the audition link. 
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1XsHVx0CpCQLZxB6EZ73Y5hmODkhYqIvlH-w73q4FQ2I/viewform?edit_requested=true

Thank you!

Der Kino Mittwoch auf radioYpsilon, deinem Lieblingssender 

MOVIETIME KW 36/2026

ZWEI FLÜCHTIGE IM SOMMERCAMP, ALARM IN DER WIESE UND DIE BERGIDYLLE WIRD ZUM ALBTRAUM

Das gewisse Etwas ist ein Remake des frz Film Un p'tit truc en plus. Ob die Version Made in Germany tatsächlich ein Wohlfühlmovie ist oder ob man doch beim Original bleiben soll, erfahren Sie bei uns.

Die beiden tollpatschigen Ameisensoldaten Arnie und Barney erlangten ursprünglich als beliebte Nebencharaktere in den „Die Biene Maja“-Kinofilmen Kultstatus. Nun bekommen sie in dem von Studio 100 International produzierten Spin-off ihr erstes eigenes, 75-minütiges Kinoabenteuer. Wie witzig oder doch steril das ganze ist, erzählt Ihnen Sarah Fuchs.

Wenn der Urlaub in den österreichischen Alpen zur Konfliktlösung dient, darüber erzählt Regisseur Mike van Diem in einem Interview über seinen neuesten Film OUR GIRLS und unsere Moderatorin besuchte die musikalische Filmreise im Schloss Kirchstetten und fand mit Stefan Gartner einen kompetenten Gesprächspartner.

Musikalisch gedenken wir den kürzlich verstorbenen Tim Curry.

Mittwoch 2.9.2026 von 18 bis 19h auf radioYpsilon 94.5 oder via Stream (http://mp3.radioypsilon.at:8000/)

🎥 In diesem Reel spricht Mag. Günther Wildner über die Anforderungen an einen Text, an ein Buch. 

👉 Sei dabei beim nächsten KBF! ✨☕️ 

📍 175. Künstler*innen Business Frühstück 
🗓️ Dienstag, 22.09.2026 – 7:15 Uhr 
🏨 Hotel Zeitgeist Vienna, Sonnwendgasse 15, 1100 Wien 

💬 Vortrag: Die Vertrauensstelle vera* 
🎙️ Heidi Fuchs 
🎤 Moderation: Andreas Huber 

Wie können Belästigung und Gewalt in Kunst und Kultur verhindert werden? Welche Herausforderungen bringt die Präventionsarbeit mit sich – und welche Chancen eröffnet sie für nachhaltige gesellschaftliche Veränderung? 

Heidi Fuchs gibt Einblick in die Arbeit von vera*, der Vertrauensstelle gegen Belästigung und Gewalt in Kunst und Kultur. Sie berichtet von Erfahrungen, Herausforderungen und Chancen der Präventionsarbeit – mit besonderem Fokus auf die Schnittstellen zwischen Kunst, Kultur und gesellschaftlicher Veränderung. 

Ein Frühstück für alle, die mehr über wirksame Prävention, sichere Arbeitsbedingungen und einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang miteinander im Kunst- und Kulturbereich erfahren möchten.

# **Currently Casting for Quidditch Performers at Warner Bros Studio Tour London**

I’m currently casting for an exciting and brand new role of **Quidditch Performer** for Warner Bros. Studio Tour London, the Making of Harry Potter ⚡️

This exciting role offers the opportunity to bring the Quidditch uniforms worn throughout the Harry Potter films to life - engaging with visitors, posing for photos, and creating magical experiences that visitors never forget.

We are seeking experienced and charismatic performers with strong acting, animation and improvisational ability, who are keen to engage with the world of Harry Potter and with to up to 7,000 visitors per day.

**Note**, no stunt experience is required.

Good availability throughout the run (beginning mid-Jan and ending mid-April) is required due to the nature of the role, the training commitments involved, and the fixed duration of the contract. All rehearsals and training must be attended by all successful candidates.

**Role Requirements**
⚡️ To portray our characters, actors must convincingly portray a playing age of 13-18 years old
⚡️ All performers must be comfortable styling their hair and/or makeup independently, with the guidance of Show Experience Management according to the requirements of the character they are portraying
⚡️ Character presentation standards for this role include being clean-shaven for all shifts. We welcome applications from candidates for whom this may not be possible; please raise this at application stage so we can discuss available options
⚡️ Any tattoos must not be visible
⚡️ Hair must be of natural tone or willing to be dyed to a natural shade once the run begins
⚡️ Comfortable being photographed and videoed by and with visitors
⚡️ Comfortable working in crowded and fast paced environments, working under show lighting, special effects and loud noises
⚡️ Comfortable handling props with a variety of shapes and weights
⚡️ Able to contribute positively and enjoy working effectively as part of a large and varied team
⚡️ Demonstrable ability to learn new skills and adapt to new situations within a visitor focused environment
⚡️ Eagerness to exceed expectations and go the extra mile at every opportunity

**All applicants must be available for the following dates:**
12th – 14th October – Auditions
15th – 16th October – Recall Auditions
3rd Nov – 9th Dec – Costume Fittings (1 hour slot on a weekday)
7th -8th January - Training
11th – 22nd January – Rehearsals
23rd January – 19th April – Run begins (we are seeking performers with 3-5 days availability including weekends and bank holidays)

If you are interested, please click the link here to see the job advert and apply: [https://flextalent.wbd.com/job/performer-quidditch-player-in-watford-england-7231753](https://flextalent.wbd.com/job/performer-quidditch-player-in-watford-england-7231753)

Georgie Glover
Show Experience Manager
Warner Bros. Studio Tour London

**CASTING CALL – GO BEFORE DAWN (SERIES)**

We’re currently casting **CALEB**, a new supporting character appearing in the final scene of the *Go Before Dawn* pilot, with the intention of **returning in a future episode**.

**CALEB**
Male | Playing age: **18–22**

Caleb is discovered injured following a violent encounter and is brought back to the settlement that the main characters live in. Although his appearance in the pilot is brief, the character will reappear in a future episode.

**Location:** Dorset
**Shoot Date:** Sunday 13th September

We’re looking for someone reliable, comfortable with physical/injury-based acting and interested in potentially returning to the role for future filming. The role is unpaid however a great experience for any newcomers who're trying to get into acting.

If interested, please get in touch with a comment or message request and we'll talk more! Thanks!

🎬 Calling all filmmakers, writers, directors, actors, and storytellers!
If you're looking for a welcoming community of creative people, I highly recommend checking out Storyteller Sessions on Discord.

It's more than just a place to network—it's a friendly, supportive community where you can meet other creatives, make genuine friendships, collaborate on projects, and grow together. Whether you're just starting out or already working in the industry, everyone is welcome.

We regularly host live Zoom table reads, where you can submit your own scripts and hear them performed by talented actors while receiving valuable feedback. We also host special events featuring professionals currently working in the film and television industry who share their experiences and insights.

If you don't already have Discord, don't worry—it's completely free to create an account and join the community.

If you're passionate about storytelling and want to connect with other creatives, we'd love to have you!

Join Storyteller Sessions here: https://discord.gg/6E6cb8NaU

I hope to see you all there!

🎬 CASTING CALL

007 CASTING AGENCY is currently seeking MALE TALENT, 18–25 YEARS for two featured film roles.

SIYA

Male | 18–25 | XHOSA-SPEAKING

A charismatic, sharp-tongued and high-energy young man with natural confidence and street-smart charm. Quick-thinking, funny and unpredictable, Siya has a strong presence but also a more caring and vulnerable side beneath his tough exterior.

We’re looking for:
• Strong personality and screen presence
• Natural charisma and confidence
• Good comedic timing
• Ability to handle emotional and confrontational scenes
• Strong isiXhosa speaking ability

BONGI

Male | 18–25 | XHOSA-SPEAKING

A warm, gentle and likeable young man with a bigger physical presence and a natural sense of rhythm. Affectionate, creative and eager to please, Bongi requires an actor who can bring both humour and emotional depth to the role.

We’re looking for:
• Warm and natural personality
• Good comedic and emotional range
• Natural sense of rhythm / dancing ability
• Strong isiXhosa speaking ability
• Ability to portray vulnerability and emotional conflict

🎥 AUDITION PROCESS

Selected applicants will receive audition sides and self-tape instructions.

Acting experience is welcome, but strong natural performers with the right presence and ability are encouraged to apply.

CASTING REQUIREMENTS

👤 Male
🎂 18–25 years
🗣️ IsiXhosa-speaking
🎭 Strong screen presence and performance ability

📩 TO APPLY

Please send your:

• Full name
• Age
• Location
• Contact number
• Recent headshot/photo

📧 info@007castingagency.co.za
📱 069 221 5294

Subject: SIYA / BONGI CASTING

Please apply only if you meet the specified requirements.

007 CASTING AGENCY

NON-UNION | NON-PAID / VOLUNTEER

God Never Fails Productions is a nonprofit production company that partners with Kingdom creatives to tell high-quality, faith-based stories. We are currently casting our upcoming short film, AMERICAN, a political drama thriller filming in the Houston area.

Logline

When a beloved right-wing evangelical congressman helps pass a harsh deportation order, he is forced to confront the human cost of his convictions—and question the theology he believes he has built his life, faith, and political platform upon.

We are casting lead, supporting, featured, background, and child roles for actors of various ages and ethnicities.

Production: Short Film

Location: Houston, TX

Union Status: Non-Union

Compensation: Non-Paid / Volunteer

Provided: Meals, IMDb credit, footage for demo reels, and portfolio/networking opportunities

Casting Window: September 3–17, 2026

Self-Tapes: Accepted

We’re looking for passionate actors who want to help bring a challenging, timely, and thought-provoking faith-based story to life.

Apply here:

 

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScTuWf5YVC36_Cl_SC2DzfYV0VhOMmnhyMmBIJkEU1pYkFP3g/viewform?usp=header

Please share with your acting community or tag someone who may be a great fit!

Hey everyone! I’m a Casting Producer for Property Brothers and casting is now OPEN for homeowners with home renovation dreams in Vancouver! 

We’re looking for:

• Homeowners who have recently purchased a home

• A minimum renovation budget of $75K

• At least 3 rooms in need of renovation

• Availability for filming beginning in early Fall 2026 & into 2027

If your new home is full of potential and you’re ready for a transformation, we’d love to hear from you.

topComments.text: “All budget tiers!” Proceeds to say the minimum is 75 thousand dollars 🤣

Do you ever feature disability specific home Reno’s? 

Homeowners can claim up to $10k in a calendar/tax year for Reno’s designed to improve accessibility and safety for people with disabilities. If the timing is just right ($10k paid in fall, $10k paid in the new year) homeowners could access $20k in tax credits, and then kick in the rest of the money for superficial / cosmetic upgrades. 

It would be really cool to see families of people with disabilities being visible on a home show & it’s possible that the Property Brothers could partner with charities all over B.C. if they wanted to donate “over and above” for a family in need who didn’t have the extra funds (due to the vast majority of primary caregivers for children with disabilities being unable to hold full time employment) 

It’s a thought. I’d definitely watch—sadly our $10k for the year is already spent.

‼️ CASTING DO NOWEGO FORMATU TELEWIZYJNEGO 📺

MASZ 18–30 LAT? DAMY CI SZANSĘ PRZEŻYĆ COŚ ZUPEŁNIE NOWEGO! 🎉

Powstaje nowy profesjonalny projekt telewizyjny oparty na prawdziwych ludziach, autentycznych spotkaniach i sytuacjach, których nie da się do końca zaplanować.

👉🏼 Szukamy młodych dorosłych w wieku 18–30 lat z całej Polski.

❌ Nie musisz być influencerem, aktorem ani mieć żadnego doświadczenia przed kamerą.

Wręcz przeciwnie — najbardziej interesuje nas to, jaki/jaka jesteś naprawdę. 👍

🔎 KOGO SZUKAMY?

Szukamy bardzo różnych osób i bardzo różnych historii.

💫 Możesz studiować, pracować, prowadzić własny biznes albo właśnie zastanawiać się, co dalej.

💫 Możesz mieszkać w dużym mieście, małej miejscowości albo na wsi.

💫 Możesz kochać sport, podróże, muzykę, gotowanie, motoryzację, technologię, sztukę, gry, taniec, majsterkowanie, internet albo mieć zainteresowanie, którego kompletnie się nie spodziewamy.

💫 Możesz być duszą towarzystwa albo introwertykiem. Mieć mnóstwo energii albo spokojnie obserwować świat. Mieć za sobą niezwykłą historię albo uważać swoje życie za zupełnie zwyczajne.

❌ Nie szukamy jednego typu człowieka.

✅ Najważniejsze, żebyś miał/miała własną osobowość, ciekawość ludzi i gotowość na nowe doświadczenie.

📺 O CO CHODZI?

Tego na etapie otwartego castingu nie chcemy jeszcze zdradzać. 😃

Możemy powiedzieć jedno:

➡️ Wybrane osoby zaprosimy do udziału w nietypowym doświadczeniu, w którym liczyć się będą prawdziwi ludzie, ich osobowości, reakcje, emocje i różne sposoby patrzenia na życie.

❗️ To nie jest casting aktorski. Nie będziesz odgrywać napisanej roli.

😍 Interesuje nas Twoja prawdziwa osobowość i to, co wydarzy się naprawdę.

😊 Szczegóły projektu przedstawimy osobom zaproszonym do kolejnego etapu castingu.

✅ CHCESZ SPRÓBOWAĆ?

📩 Wyślij zgłoszenie na adres:

casting.miedzypokoleniami@tvp.pl

W zgłoszeniu podaj:

• imię i wiek,
• miejscowość,
• numer telefonu,
• aktualne zdjęcie,
• kilka zdań o sobie i swoich zainteresowaniach,
• link do Instagrama / TikToka — jeśli korzystasz,
• krótki film nagrany telefonem (ok. 1–2 min).

🎬 Na filmie odpowiedz po prostu:

👉🏼 Kim jesteś?
👉🏼 Co najbardziej Cię wciąga?
👉🏼 Co jest dla Ciebie ważne?
👉🏼 Czego jeszcze chciałbyś/chciałabyś w życiu spróbować?

🙌🏼 Nie montuj. Nie przygotowuj przemowy. Nie próbuj być „telewizyjny/a”.

📱 Telefon, minuta lub dwie i Ty. 🫵🏼

👉🏼 Jeżeli przejdziesz pierwszy etap, skontaktujemy się z Tobą i opowiemy więcej.

A jeśli podczas czytania pomyślałeś/pomyślałaś o swoim znajomym lub przyjacielu — wyślij mu/jej to ogłoszenie.

Być może właśnie takiej osoby szukamy. 👍

sharedPost.text:
On this day I felt so small. 😪
Everyone came with finished art pieces, beautiful products in their hands. I came with a piece of cardboard. A vision board.

No product. Just a dream written in a pen 🖊 The Blaq Spider Pantsula 🇿🇦 — Vision, Mission, Dreams.

I thought they would laugh at me. But that board had more truth and prophecy. It had my future. It had aeroplanes — because I see us flying internationally. It had my brothers — because I see us as a company, not just dancers.

They had art. I had a prophecy.

 I was not small. I was just early. 🕷️

#blaqspiderpantsula #kingsporo #alwayshungry #borntohustle #kasipreneur 🖤🦅

**Title: ACTS OF MERCY**

**Genre: ***Drama*

**Logline: **Following the death of her mother, a veterinarian faces addiction and guilt as she tries to evade grief.

**Roles:**

**MAGNOLIA **- *LEAD - Female, 20-35*

Magnolia is no stranger to death, running an in-home animal hospital, yet refuses to grieve the death of her mother. She faces guilt, addiction, and drug induced hallucinations, but continually tries to bury her feelings.

**MARIE **- *SUPPORTING - Female, 40-60*

Marie is eccentric, confident in her decisions, and unafraid to grieve. She knows that euthanizing her cat will prevent it from suffering longer, but that doesn't lessen the impact of loss. She feels no embarrassment when expressing her grief.

**Director**: Evangeline Buchenberger

**Production Type**: Short Film

**Contact Information**: sirjackofalltrades@gmail.com

**Run Time**: Short

**Compensation**: Unpaid. Snacks provided, meals, credit, and copy of final film.

**Union Status**: Non-Union

**Audition Information**:

**IN-PERSON AUDITIONS** at CCA's Cinematic Arts Open Auditions, 9075 E Lowry Blvd. Denver, CO 80230.

Friday, September 4th, 10AM-5pm and Saturday, September 5th 10am-4pm.

**SELF TAPE AUDITIONS**: please send an email to sirjackofalltrades@gmail.com with the subject line "ACTS OF MERCY CASTING - YOUR NAME". Please also include a recent headshot, resume, and demo reel, if available, and we will send you sides to send in as a self tape.

**Shooting Schedule**: October 14th, 16-19th.

**Filming Location**: Denver area

**Project Notes**: Please note that this project contains references to drug use, self harm, and euthanasia.

CASTING CALL:
Title: Sugarwater
Genre: Sci-fi/horror, student short film
Logline: Two construction workers uncover a strange creature in the dirt.

Characters:

Cam (M, 20s-30s, LEAD): 
An enamored construction worker with his head in the clouds.

Riley (M, 20s-30s, LEAD):
A sensible worker just trying to get through the day.

TV Woman (F, 20s-30s, SUPPORTING):
An old-Hollywood starlet radiating glamor.

TV Man (M, 20s-30s, SUPPORTING):
A classic noir antihero with a tendency to break hearts.

Shooting will take place over 4 days in November for Cam and Riley, and one day in October for the TV Woman and TV Man, all in or around the Denver, CO area. Compensation will be meals, gas compensation, credit, and a copy of the final film. The final film will be exhibited at CU Denver's Cinefest in May 2027 and will then be submitted to other film festivals for further distribution.

Use this link or scan the QR code in the flyer below to access to audition form: https://forms.gle/v9PMj5nAh4wV7fpA8

If you have any questions, feel free to contact me at caitlin.lebakken@cuanschutz.edu. Thank you!

🚨*CASTING CALL*🚨

Für den Abschlussfilm „TOTENBUCH“ von Lennart Glossner an der Hochschule Darmstadt sind wir noch dringend auf der Suche nach Kleindarsteller*innen und Kompars*innen.

*Darum gehts:*
Als der aktivistische Künstler Ben den Nachlass seines verstorbenen kleinen Bruders Ric sichtet, zwingt ihn ein hinterbliebenes Tagebuch in die wahnhafte Auseinandersetzung mit einer rechtsextremen Lebensrealität. TOTENBUCH ist ein 20-minütiger, experimenteller Kurzfilm, der die Themen Brüderliebe und Verlust zwischen politischen Fronten verhandelt. 

*Rollen, die wir noch suchen:*

Kleindarsteller*innen (mit Text)

- Schüler*innen (18 - 23 Jahre)

- ⁠Schuldirektorin (über 35 Jahre)

- Besitzer eines Imbissladens (über 30 Jahre, migrantisch gelesen)

Kompars*innen

- ⁠Altfaschist/ Gast einer rechtsextremen Rede (über 30 Jahre)
- Schüler/innen (18-23 Jahre)
- ⁠feste Freundinnen der rechtsextremen Gruppe (kaukasisch gelesen, deutschsprachig, 18-25 Jahre)
- ⁠Mutter mit Kopftuch (20-40 Jahre, migrantisch gelesen)
- ⁠Punk/ Person aus der alternativen Szene (über 18 Jahre)
- Kunden im Imbissladen
- ⁠…

*Infos und Kontakt:*

Dreh am 18.09.26 und 19.09.26 (du musst nicht beide Tage verfügbar sein)
Ort: Darmstadt und Umgebung

Da es sich um einen studentischen Abschlussfilm handelt, können wir leider keine Gage anbieten und auch keine Fahrtkosten übernehmen. Für Verpflegung am Set ist selbstverständlich gesorgt. Einige Rollen erfordern das Agieren in einem politisch sensiblen Kontext. Um die Ernsthaftigkeit des Themas darzustellen streben wir einen verantwortungsbewussten Umgang mit der Thematik an.

Bei Interesse meldet euch gerne mit ein paar Infos zu euch (Name, Alter, Wohnort, Kontakt) und idealerweise mit einem aktuellen Foto und/oder Showreel. Auch ohne vorherige Schauspielerfahrung könnt ihr euch gerne bewerben! Uns ist vor allem wichtig, dass ihr Lust auf das Projekt und die Rolle habt.
Unter folgender E-Mail Adresse sind wir zu erreichen:

casting.totenbuch@gmail.com

Wir freuen uns auf euch:))

🎙️ SPRECHER:INNEN GESUCHT – Casting in Berlin (20€, garantiert!)

Du redest gerne und dein Deutsch ist flüssig? Dann bewirb dich fürs Casting!

Zu dritt führt ihr ein lockeres, improvisiertes Gespräch zu einem Thema (6–8 Minuten) und macht danach ein paar kurze Übungen mit Text. Insgesamt dauert das Ganze nur 15–20 Minuten – in zentraler Lage in Berlin.

📅 Termin: Mittwoch, 9. September

💰 20€ für deine Teilnahme – unabhängig vom Ergebnis!

🎓 Nichts vorzubereiten, nichts auswendig zu lernen – einfach so sprechen wie immer

Wirst du ausgewählt, geht's weiter mit wöchentlichen Aufnahme-Sessions (45€ brutto/Std., 4–8 Std.) auf Vertragsbasis als selbstständige:r Auftragnehmer:in, Auszahlung über die Plattform Dots.

Die Aufnahmen werden für Sprach-KI & virtuelle Assistenten genutzt – kein Stimmklon.

✅ Formular ausfüllen dauert nur 3–4 Minuten. Genaue Uhrzeit & Adresse werden telefonisch mit dir bestätigt.

⚠️ Es wird nie Geld von dir verlangt, niemand fragt vorab nach Bankdaten, Ausweis oder Adresse.

Für unser HFF-Sonderprojekt **„Arizona, Arizona“** suchen wir für den **02.09.2026** noch **männliche Kompars*innen zwischen ca. 25 und 70 Jahren**, die **LKW-Fahrer** spielen.

Gedreht wird im **Innenraum einer Gaststätte**. Das genaue Motiv geben wir noch bekannt. Wir fahren gemeinsam **von München aus zum Drehort**, eine eigene Anreise ist daher nicht notwendig.

Besonders freuen wir uns über Menschen, die selbst Erfahrung als LKW-Fahrer haben oder optisch gut in das Umfeld passen.

Da es sich um ein No-Budget-Hochschulprojekt handelt, können wir leider keine Gage zahlen. Für Verpflegung am Set ist gesorgt.

Bei Interesse meldet euch gerne mit einem kurzen Foto und ein paar Infos zu euch unter **helena.bublak@campus.hff-muc.de**.

🎬 CASTING CALL – FEMALE LEAD ROLE | SHORT FILM

I’m looking to cast the lead role of Emily in my upcoming short film Good Grief, which I’ve written and am directing.

This is my first short film project, and it’s a passion project that I’m putting a lot of time, care and attention into. The rest of the cast is already in place, the locations and props are sorted, and we’re now just looking for the right actress to bring Emily to life.

🎭 ROLE: EMILY

Female | Mid-20s (22 to 26) White/Caucasian 

Emily is sensitive, warm, introspective and deeply emotional. This is a lead role and the character carries much of the film, so I’m looking for someone who can really nail the emotional scenes and bring a genuine, natural performance rather than simply delivering lines.

There are some particularly emotional moments in the film, so emotional range and the ability to convey grief, love and vulnerability naturally are really important.

🎥 THE FILM

Good Grief is an intimate, cinematic short film exploring love, grief, memory and the softness we carry after losing someone we love.

The film is being made with film festival submissions in mind, and I’m passionate about creating something visually beautiful and emotionally meaningful.

📍 Location: Haworth, West Yorkshire
📅 Filming: September 2026 — exact date to be confirmed
⏱️ Duration: Approx. 10–15 minutes
💷 Payment: Unpaid — this is my first independent short film and is being made as a passion project. All production elements, props and the rest of the cast are already organised.

I completely appreciate that unpaid work isn’t for everyone, but if you’re an actress who is passionate about acting and would love to be part of a small, ambitious short film, I’d love to hear from you. If however there is an actor who has a lot of experience already I could try to find a way to pay a fee. 

📩 TO APPLY

Please DM me with:

• Headshot
• Showreel / previous acting work (if available)
• Spotlight link (if applicable)
• Location
• Availability in September

I’ll send Emily’s dialogue / casting tape material to anyone interested in auditioning.

Please feel free to share or tag any actresses who you think could be right for the role.

Thank you! 🎬

Project: DAS NACHTVOLK (THE NIGHT FOLK)
Format: Short Film / Music Video
Tone: Atmospheric Dark Folklore / Gothic Metal Thriller
Language Requirement: German & English (Must speak both fluently)
Shoot Location: Marburg, Germany (Preference given to locals)
Union Status: Non-Union
Pay: 200 € per 8-hour day

LOGLINE & SYNOPSIS
Logline: When the alluring music of the Night Folk claims her impulsive lover, a grounded teen in 1860s Germany must face the phantom call before it sweeps away her remaining family.
Synopsis: In 1860s Germany, a fiercely practical girl mourns her reckless lover after he succumbs to the hypnotic melodies of the Night Folk. But as the solemn phantom march winds through the timeless streets of Old Marburg and lays claim to her own family, a haunting, transcendent choice awaits her in the shadows.

CASTING SPECS:

1860s GRANDFATHER – Male. 60-70. German. Talented, determined, yet ailing. While once fun and
jovial, he is now a physically frail widower raising his teenage granddaughter. He struggles to navigate a
rapidly changing world, deeply frustrated that his traditional, hard-earned wisdom is being brushed aside
by a restless new generation. A gifted musician no longer able to play. MUST SPEAK GERMAN AND
ENGLISH FLUENTLY.
Works 2 days between October 28th-31st, tentatively 29th and 31st

1860s GIRL – Female. 14-16. German. Sharp-witted, fiercely practical, and grounded. While she
possesses a deeply passionate soul, she approaches life with logic, caution, and a mature sense of
responsibility. She takes excellent care of her ailing grandfather, even if she is the source of his
frustration and concern. Fiery but devoted, she’s a lovable spirit trying to carve her own path in trying
times. MUST SPEAK GERMAN AND ENGLISH FLUENTLY.
Works 3 days, between October 28th-31st, tentatively 28th, 29th, and 31st

1860s BOY – Male. 16-18. German. Fiercely driven, cunning, but loyal. A bit rebellious and careless at
times, he lives entirely in the moment and is easily carried away by the raw emotion of a situation. He is
an idealist who acts first and thinks later, constantly ignoring societal constraints. A magnetic personality
who refuses to conform, he is a reckless visionary. MUST SPEAK GERMAN AND ENGLISH FLUENTLY.
Works 2 days, between October 28th-31st, tentatively 28th and 29th 

Send your photo, resume and reel to ganna@intheweehours.com 
Subject:  NACHTVOLK (THE NIGHT FOLK)

Language Requirement: German & English (Must speak both fluently)
Shoot Location: Marburg, Germany (Preference given to locals)
Union Status: Non-Union
Pay: 200 € per 8-hour day

LOGLINE & SYNOPSIS
Logline: When the alluring music of the Night Folk claims her impulsive lover, a grounded teen in 1860s Germany must face the phantom call before it sweeps away her remaining family.
Synopsis: In 1860s Germany, a fiercely practical girl mourns her reckless lover after he succumbs to the hypnotic melodies of the Night Folk. But as the solemn phantom march winds through the timeless streets of Old Marburg and lays claim to her own family, a haunting, transcendent choice awaits her in the shadows.

CASTING SPECS:

1860s GRANDFATHER – Male. 60-70. German. Talented, determined, yet ailing. While once fun and
jovial, he is now a physically frail widower raising his teenage granddaughter. He struggles to navigate a
rapidly changing world, deeply frustrated that his traditional, hard-earned wisdom is being brushed aside
by a restless new generation. A gifted musician no longer able to play. MUST SPEAK GERMAN AND
ENGLISH FLUENTLY.
Works 2 days between October 28th-31st, tentatively 29th and 31st

1860s GIRL – Female. 14-16. German. Sharp-witted, fiercely practical, and grounded. While she
possesses a deeply passionate soul, she approaches life with logic, caution, and a mature sense of
responsibility. She takes excellent care of her ailing grandfather, even if she is the source of his
frustration and concern. Fiery but devoted, she’s a lovable spirit trying to carve her own path in trying
times. MUST SPEAK GERMAN AND ENGLISH FLUENTLY.
Works 3 days, between October 28th-31st, tentatively 28th, 29th, and 31st

1860s BOY – Male. 16-18. German. Fiercely driven, cunning, but loyal. A bit rebellious and careless at
times, he lives entirely in the moment and is easily carried away by the raw emotion of a situation. He is
an idealist who acts first and thinks later, constantly ignoring societal constraints. A magnetic personality
who refuses to conform, he is a reckless visionary. MUST SPEAK GERMAN AND ENGLISH FLUENTLY.
Works 2 days, between October 28th-31st, tentatively 28th and 29th 

Send your photo, resume and reel to ganna@intheweehours.com 
Subject:  NACHTVOLK (THE NIGHT FOLK)

🎬 **CASTING CALL – YOUNG MALE ACTORS PLAYING AGE 16–19 **

The Paul Lavelle Foundation & Big Egg Films are casting for ‘Healthy Doesn’t Hurt’, a powerful youth short film exploring healthy and unhealthy relationships, abuse, consent, misogyny and misandry.

We are looking for:

•            Young men to portray gay male main character roles

•            Young men for a range of supporting roles

We particularly welcome LGBTQ+ applicants, although nobody will be expected to disclose their sexuality.  Actors applying for the gay male roles simply need to feel comfortable portraying the characters and relationships respectfully.

No professional acting experience is essential confidence, reliability and natural acting ability are most important.

**Compensation:** Showreel, exposure, travel expenses & refreshments

📍 Filming in Wirral/Liverpool Merseyside

🎥 Filming: Must be available the week of 26th – 30th October 26.

🔒 Parent or guardian consent will be required for under 18s.

For more information or to apply, please send an email to request our self-tape audition pack to 

**casting@paullavellefoundation.co.uk**

Cześć! Szukamy mężczyzn w wieku (18-30)do udziału w naszym filmie krótkometrażowym, realizowanym w ramach niezależnej produkcji studenckiej.

Poszukujemy osób do ról statystów oraz bohaterów epizodycznych, wcielających się w grupę młodych ludzi o „patologicznym” / ulicznym charakterze. Zależy nam na osobach, które naturalnie pasują do takiego wizerunku — doświadczenie aktorskie nie jest wymagane.

🎥 Film krótkometrażowy
🎓 Projekt studencki, niezależny, non-profit
📍 Poznań
📅 Zdjęcia: 3–4 października
🎭 Statyści / role epizodyczne

Jeśli jesteś zainteresowany, napisz na:

📩 email.od.filmow@gmail.com

W zgłoszeniu podeślij kilka słów o sobie oraz aktualne zdjęcie. Jeśli masz doświadczenie przed kamerą lub materiały aktorskie, również możesz je dołączyć.

Masz znajomych, którzy pasują do opisu? Podeślij im ogłoszenie! 🎬

topComments.text: Idealnie bym się nadawał, całe życie jako patus haha. Ale szkoda tylko, że to w Poznaniu...

I’m also often complimented on my personality, positive energy, and the way I light up a room.

I’ve always been encouraged to consider modeling, and I’m finally ready to explore it and see where my natural look, confidence, personality, and presence could take me. I’m particularly interested in beauty, lifestyle, commercial, fashion, and print modeling.

I’d love to connect with anyone who can offer legitimate opportunities, advice, collaborations, or recommendations as I begin this journey.

CASTING NOTICE – LACRECIA STRYKER

Project: DULCE
Format: Sci-Fi / Action Series Pilot
Production Company: 10th Legion Pictures
Location: Hubert, North Carolina
Shoot Date: October 2026 – Exact Date TBD
Role: Supporting
Compensation: $200 flat – One-Day Shoot
Female, Black, 35–50, plus-size/heavyset.

Lacrecia is the outspoken, larger-than-life wife of Colonel Marcus Stryker. Loud, animated, funny, affectionate, and completely unimpressed by her husband's military rank.
The role requires strong comedic timing and an actress who can deliver bold dialogue naturally without making the character feel exaggerated or cartoonish. The scene contains mildly suggestive marital humor and a brief kiss between husband and wife. 

SUBMISSIONS
To be considered for the role of Lacrecia Stryker, please submit through the 10th Legion Pictures Actor Submission page:

https://www.10thlegionpictures.com/actor-submission

Selected applicants will be contacted with sides and instructions for a self-taped audition.

ABOUT THE PROJECT
DULCE is a science-fiction/action series pilot being produced by 10th Legion Pictures. The pilot combines military action, science fiction, horror, and dark comedy and is intended as the launching point for a larger series.

CASTING CALL: MOM, 40s
Axis is casting a woman in her 40s for a short, cinematic Advent video filming in Centennial, Colorado.

The character is a relatable, overwhelmed mom trying to keep up with the chaos of Christmas. We are looking for an actor with strong comedic instincts who can also bring warmth, subtlety, and emotional honesty to the role.
Filming date: September 17
Time: 8:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.
Location: Centennial, Colorado
Pay: $500
To submit, please email the following to [Irene@axis.org](mailto:Irene@axis.org) by September 9:

- Self-tape using the attached audition side
- Current headshot
- Acting resume
- Reel, if available
Please use the subject line: “Advent Light Audition – [Your Name]”
Include your phone number and confirmation that you are available for the full filming window. This role includes both on-camera performance and voiceover.

**Title**: **IS THAT YOU, GOD?**

**Genre**: *Horror*

**Logline**: When young Anastasia confides in God ... He speaks back. Though, she soon realizes there is no escape from the restrictions of religion.

Roles:

**ANASTASIA** - *LEAD* - *Female, 8-15*

Quiet, but curious. Naive and sweet. She's always trying to find comfort within the religion her mother forces upon her.

**MOTHER** - *SUPPORTING* - *Female, 40-60*

Strict and snappy. An incredibly catholic woman who *will* make her daughter a follower as well.

**"GOD"** - *SUPPORTING - Male, 30-55*

A voice that Anastasia believes to be the one, true God speaking back to her. Determined, he will stop at nothing to get Anastasia. 

**FATHER MICHAEL** - *SUPPORTING - Male, 40+*

A kind and professional priest, trying to help Anastasia take the correct first steps in her faith.

**Director**: Lizzie Kleewein

**Production Type**: Short Film

**Contact Information**: sirjackofalltrades@gmail.com

**Run Time**: Short

**Compensation**: Unpaid. Snacks provided, meals, credit, and copy of final film.

**Union Status**: Non-Union

**Audition Information**: 

**IN-PERSON AUDITIONS** at CCA's Cinematic Arts Open Auditions, 9075 E Lowry Blvd. Denver, CO 80230.

THIS WEEKEND

Friday, September 4th, 10AM-5pm and Saturday, September 5th 1pm-4pm.

**SELF TAPE AUDITIONS**: please send an email to sirjackofalltrades@gmail.com with the subject line "IS THAT YOU, GOD? - YOUR NAME". Please also include a recent headshot, resume, and demo reel, if available, and we will provide sides to send in a self tape.

**Shooting Schedule**: October 23-26th, and 28th.

**Filming Location**: Denver area

**Project Notes**: Please note that this project contains references to religious trauma.

Hey! I am working on 2 shows that is looking for people who are passionate about all things nerd culture. There is compensation and films in Los Angeles. It’s like Jubilee but discussing Sci-fi, Comics, anime, TTRPGs, DnD, GTA, Video Games, Manga, etc.
One show you rank your favs and talk it out with some of the creators. 
The second has you debate a celebrity on your fav shows, games, comics, anime etc. Let me know if you have any questions and if you know someone who would be great for either of these shows, please share the flyers.

Hello everyone! My name is Lauren Lusk** **and I’m the Casting Director** **for the UNCSA Fourth Year Thesis film, ***SHADES OF LAVENDER***. We are casting our lead characters!

Story: Nine-year-old DALIA and her mother, NERA, try to reconnect on a mother-daughter trip as one longs to grow up and the other questions the life she grew into. ** **

We are accepting self-tape** **auditions! Character Breakdowns are attached. If you’re interested in auditioning for these roles, send your **name** and **headshot **to **lavendershadescasting@gmail.com **for self-tape instructions.

The **interest & self-tape deadline **is **SEPTEMBER 17TH**! 

Production title: ***SHADES OF LAVENDER***

**🎬 Schauspieler | Kleindarsteller | Komparse aus Hamburg sucht neue Projekte**

**Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,**

mein Name ist **Nicolay Bein**, ich bin 41 Jahre alt, 1,94 m groß und lebe in Hamburg.

Aktuell bin ich auf der Suche nach **seriösen Film- und TV-Produktionen sowie neuen Möglichkeiten als Schauspieler, Kleindarsteller oder Komparse**. Besonders interessiere ich mich für Filme, Serien, Werbespots, Musikvideos, Imagefilme und weitere spannende Projekte.

Ich stehe noch **am Anfang meiner schauspielerischen Laufbahn** und möchte meine Erfahrungen vor der Kamera kontinuierlich erweitern, mich weiterentwickeln und weitere Einblicke in die Film- und Medienbranche gewinnen.

Erste Erfahrungen konnte ich bereits **als Komparse bei einem Filmdreh** sammeln. Die Arbeit am Set hat mir sehr viel Freude bereitet und meinen Wunsch bestärkt, künftig regelmäßig vor der Kamera zu stehen.

Ich bin **zuverlässig, pünktlich, motiviert, lernbereit und teamfähig**. Gleichzeitig bin ich offen für unterschiedliche Rollen und Aufgaben und freue mich darauf, mich auf neue Projekte und Herausforderungen einzulassen.

Ich stehe sowohl für **einzelne Drehtage als auch für längerfristige Projekte** zur Verfügung. Anfragen aus **Hamburg und dem gesamten Bundesgebiet** sind herzlich willkommen.

📩 Bei Interesse freue ich mich sehr über Ihre Kontaktaufnahme. Gerne sende ich Ihnen **aktuelle Fotos, meine Vita und weitere Informationen** zu.

Ich freue mich darauf, interessante Projekte kennenzulernen, weitere Erfahrungen zu sammeln und neue Kontakte in der Film- und Medienbranche zu knüpfen.

**Mit freundlichen Grüßen**

**Nicolay Bein**
🎬 Schauspieler | Kleindarsteller | Komparse
📍 Hamburg

📱 **Mobil:** 0176 4192 1114

🎬🔥 𝗖𝗔𝗦𝗧𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗖𝗔𝗟𝗟 — 𝗙𝗟𝗢𝗥𝗜𝗗𝗔 & 𝗦𝗨𝗥𝗥𝗢𝗨𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗦𝗧𝗔𝗧𝗘𝗦 🔥🎬

            ⚔️ 𝗗 𝗘 𝗙 𝗜 𝗔 𝗡 𝗖 𝗘 ⚔️
💥 𝗡𝗢𝗡-𝗨𝗡𝗜𝗢𝗡 • 𝗣𝗔𝗜𝗗 𝗥𝗢𝗟𝗘𝗦 🎥
 𝗙𝗜𝗟𝗠𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗜𝗡 𝗙𝗟𝗢𝗥𝗜𝗗𝗔 • 𝗝𝗔𝗡𝗨𝗔𝗥𝗬 29 – 𝗙𝗘𝗕𝗥𝗨𝗔𝗥𝗬 17, 2027

🎥 𝟯 𝗥𝗔𝗧𝗦 𝗘𝗡𝗧𝗘𝗥𝗧𝗔𝗜𝗡𝗠𝗘𝗡𝗧 🎬 
From the filmmakers behind 𝗞𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗿 𝗚𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗶𝗲𝘀, 𝗕𝗮𝗱 𝗕𝘂𝗻𝗻𝘆, 𝗘𝘅𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗧𝗵𝘂𝗴𝘀, 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗔𝗺𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗻 𝗥𝗶𝗽𝗽𝗲𝗿, 𝗦𝗻𝗮𝗿𝗹𝘆 𝗬𝗼𝘄, and 𝗔𝗺𝗶𝘁𝘆𝘃𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗲: 𝗠𝘁. 𝗠𝗶𝘀𝗲𝗿𝘆 𝗥𝗼𝗮𝗱 comes an ambitious new historical motion picture:

       🔥⚔️ 𝗗 𝗘 𝗙 𝗜 𝗔 𝗡 𝗖 𝗘 ⚔️🔥
𝗙𝗟𝗢𝗥𝗜𝗗𝗔 — 𝗗𝗘𝗖𝗘𝗠𝗕𝗘𝗥 28, 1835
Major Francis L. Dade and his command march deep into the Florida wilderness.
More than 100 U.S. soldiers are making their way north toward Fort King through an unforgiving frontier of pine forests, swamps and dense saw palmettos.

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝘆 𝗱𝗼𝗻'𝘁 𝗸𝗻𝗼𝘄 𝗶𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗦𝗲𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝘄𝗮𝗿𝗿𝗶𝗼𝗿𝘀 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝘄𝗮𝘁𝗰𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗶𝗿 𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘆 𝗺𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁.

Hidden within the Florida wilderness, a resistance is waiting.
Within hours, their march will erupt into one of the most dramatic and consequential battles in Florida history, an event that would help ignite the Second Seminole War and forever change the history of Florida.
Nearly 200 years later, 𝟯 𝗥𝗮𝘁𝘀 𝗘𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗶𝗻𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 is bringing this extraordinary story to the screen.
🎬 
🔥 𝗪𝗘 𝗔𝗥𝗘 𝗦𝗘𝗘𝗞𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗚𝗘𝗡𝗢𝗨𝗦 𝗔𝗖𝗧𝗢𝗥𝗦, 𝗥𝗘𝗘𝗡𝗔𝗖𝗧𝗢𝗥𝗦 & 𝗣𝗘𝗥𝗙𝗢𝗥𝗠𝗘𝗥𝗦 🔥
We are searching throughout 𝗙𝗹𝗼𝗿𝗶𝗱𝗮 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘀𝘂𝗿𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗲𝘀 for talented Indigenous performers who can authentically portray the Seminole and Black Seminole warriors and historical figures at the heart of 𝗗𝗘𝗙𝗜𝗔𝗡𝗖𝗘.
⚔️ 𝗠𝗔𝗝𝗢𝗥 𝗛𝗜𝗦𝗧𝗢𝗥𝗜𝗖𝗔𝗟 𝗥𝗢𝗟𝗘𝗦 𝗡𝗢𝗪 𝗖𝗔𝗦𝗧𝗜𝗡𝗚 ⚔️

Experience with period flintlock muskets, historical reenactment, horseback riding, wilderness skills or combat performance is a major plus.

📸 Several current photographs 🎭 Acting or reenactment experience 🎬 Film credits, if applicable 🔥 Flintlock musket experience, if applicable 🐎 Horseback riding experience, if applicable 📍 Your current city and state

items.text:
💢CASTING CALL 💢
Its that time again....

Auditions (self tapes) are now open for 'Benji jnr' and "Benji's mum". 

The cycle is a short film based around a young man struggling to break the cycle of generational and childhood trauma and the challenges he faces. 

The film is the second film of Tori Hughes, who's first film 'The Aftermath' is an award winning film and currently doing the festival circuit. 

See slides for roles, dates and details.

Please be aware that roles are currently expenses only however fundraising is ongoing and so this may change given budget. Film will be entered into the festival circuit and is built to raise awareness of themes involved. 

Please message myself, Claire Ward  or Sarah Elizabeth  if you wish to self tape. We look forward to watching! 

.

.

.

.

#shortfilmmaking  #fundraising  #RaisingAwareness  #casting  #castingcallsuk

topComments.text: Hi, Ive sent you a DM Tori West 👍👌🎬

attachments.ocrText: May be an image of text that says 'The CyeKc- CyeKue Casting call The cycle is a short film based around a young man struggling to break the cycle of generational and childhood trauma and the challenges he faces into adult life. Includes scenes of violence and addiction. Filming will take place in or around Stoke on Trent- November 2026. Roles are currently expenses only however fundraising is ongoing. Get in touch via message if you would like to self tape.'

May be an image of text that says 'The Ciol Cye- Casting Call- Benji 5 mum- 40-50 This role will encompass playing mum to our lead Benji at 2 different stages of Benji's life, both as a child and a young adult. Benji's mum struggles with alcohol addiction and substance misuse which creates a role reversal of care from Benji towards mum, however a deep connection is shown therefore good chemistry with the lead is important. Benjis mum needs to be able to show a deep vulnerabilty alongside a 'lost' but caring nature.'

May be an image of text that says 'The Cy- Cyele Casting Call- Benji Benjijnr-7-10 jnr- 7-10 Benji jnr will play the younger version of our lead Benji. Benji jnr will portray a difficult childhood and therefore will need to be able to show a range of emotions from upset to fear and affection.'

Schauspielerfahrung ist von Vorteil, aber keinesfalls notwendig. Viel wichtiger sind uns interessante Persönlichkeiten mit einer starken Ausstrahlung, die Interesse und Lust auf Film und/ oder neuen Herausforderungen haben.

**Drehort: Nürnberg **

**Drehtag: 09.10.26 oder 11.10.26.**

Da es sich um ein sehr kleines Projekt handelt, kann die Produktion leider nur eine **Aufwandsentschädigung von bis zu 300,- für den Drehtag **anbieten, ohne Reisekosten.

Wenn ihr euch angesprochen fühlt, freuen wir uns über eine Nachricht mit einem Foto und ein paar Infos zu euch an folgende E-Mail: thaikevinpilz@gmail.com

🎬 KOMPARSEN GESUCHT | WESTERN-DREH | 11.–13.09.2026 | EBERSBERG

Hallo zusammen,

für meinen Bachelor-Film „Grave Stakes“ suche ich im Raum Ebersberg bei München noch Kompars:innen für unseren Western-Dreh.

🤠 12. & 13. September 2026:
Jeweils 6 Kompars:innen pro Tag.

Western-Kleidung ist gerne gesehen, aber keine Pflicht. Ein schlichtes Hemd oder möglichst Western-like Kleidung reicht völlig aus. Westernhüte werden vor Ort zur Verfügung gestellt.

🎬 Freitag, 11. September 2026:
Hier suche ich einen Mann und eine Frau, die ein Ehepaar spielen und gemeinsam kurz durch das Bild laufen.

Bei Interesse oder Fragen meldet euch gerne direkt bei mir:

📞 0162 8235913

Drehort: Raum Ebersberg bei München

Vielen Dank!
Paul Dächert

Hallo zusammen!
Ich bin professionelle Artistin und aktuell auf der Suche nach neuen Engagements und Castings in Deutschland und Europa.

Meine Schwerpunkte sind Seiltanz / Balance-Acts, Bühne, Show und Performance. Ich bin Guinness World Record Holder und habe internationale Bühnenerfahrung, u. a. bei Britain’s Got Talent, TV-Produktionen, Varieté, Zirkus und internationalen Shows.

Ich freue mich über Kontakte zu Agenturen, Produzenten, Veranstaltern und Casting Directors sowie über Hinweise auf aktuelle Castings und Engagements.

Wohnort: Bayern | deutschlandweit & international verfügbar.
Portfolio, Videos und weitere Informationen sende ich gerne per PN.

Vielen Dank!
Oksana Seroshtan

🎪 FABRICACIÓN Y VENTA DE MONOCICLOS PROFESIONALES PERSONALIZADOS

En Mundo Circense SXE fabricamos monociclos especiales para artistas, compañías, escuelas y espectáculos circenses.

Presentamos nuestro monociclo adaptable de tres ruedas, aro 20, elaborado en acero inoxidable y diseñado para brindar resistencia, estabilidad y presencia escénica.

✅ Tres ruedas aro 20
✅ Estructura en acero inoxidable
✅ Modelo adaptable
✅ Asientos anatómicos con protectores de caída
✅ Personalización con el nombre o logotipo de la empresa, compañía o artista

El precio incluye dos cobertores protectores personalizados para facilitar su cuidado y traslado.

📏 Medidas de cada cobertor:
1 metro de largo × 50 cm de alto × 20 cm de fondo.

Fabricamos cada ejemplar por encargo, atendiendo las necesidades y características del artista.

🌎 Realizamos pedidos para Perú y otros países.

📩 Solicita información, precio y condiciones de fabricación por mensaje privado o WhatsApp.

Mundo Circense SXE
Diseño y fabricación de aparatos profesionales para espectáculos.

🎬 STATYŚCI – 16.09 WARSZAWA

Na plan filmu historycznego osadzonego w XIX wieku
Jako mieszkańcy Powiśla, poszukujemy mężczyzn w różnym wieku i o różnym wyglądzie.

⚠️ Uwaga! To inny film niż dotychczas realizowany przeze mnie.
Szukam mężczyzn do projekt PAULI - tylko osoby, które nie brały jeszcze udziału 

📅 ZDJĘCIA: 16.09 – Warszawa
PRZYMIARKI: 09.09 – Mokotów

💰 Stawka łączna z przymiarkami: 180 zł netto (płatność gotówką po zdjęciach)

📩 ZGŁOSZENIA MAILOWO:
juliacast.kontakt@gmail.com

TYTUŁ MAILA: POWIŚLE

W treści zgłoszenia proszę podać:

- imię i nazwisko,
- wiek,
- wzrost,
- numer telefonu,
- informację o posiadanych tatuażach,
- informację o aparacie ortodontycznym.

📸 Koniecznie aktualne zdjęcia:

- twarzy,
- całej sylwetki,
- fryzury z boku,
- fryzury od tyłu.

Casting dla chłopców! Łódź!
💸Do realizacji etiudy fabularnej IIIr reżyserii PWSFTviT w Łodzi poszukujemy ❗️DWÓCH CHŁOPCÓW❗️ (ok. 8-13 lat, najlepiej BRACIA) z Łodzi do roli epizodycznej dzieciaków z blokowiska przesiadujących na podwórku, placu zabaw. 

ZDJĘCIA:

📌ŁÓDŹ

🗓️14-17 września (jeden dzień)

ROLA - DWÓJKA CHŁOPCÓW Z BLOKOWISKA 

- wiek między 8 a 13 lat

- dziecięca lecz zarazem „łobuzerska” uroda 

- wymagany dokument PIP

- poszukujemy młodych aktorów z Łodzi

Najchętniej podejmiemy współpracę z rodzeństwem, jednakże jesteśmy równie otwarci na pojedyncze zgłoszenia. 

Proszę o załączenie fotografii biometrycznej oraz ewentualnego portfolio.

📩Zachęcam do kontaktu za pośrednictwem fb: Zuzanna Kubańska lub maila: zuzannna.kubanska@gmail.com

Do zobaczenia na planie!

Jesteś aktorem lub modelem i szukasz nowych projektów? A może po prostu szukasz sposobu na dodatkowy zarobek? Możesz zarabiać na własnym wizerunku, nie wychodząc z domu.

Ruszamy z AlterCast – platformą, która pozwala stworzyć Twojego cyfrowego "bliźniaka" do reklam. Zapraszamy profesjonalistów, ale szukamy też osób o każdym typie urody (nie musisz mieć doświadczenia przed kamerą).

Zasady są proste i w 100% bezpieczne:
* **Pełna kontrola:** sam decydujesz, w jakich branżach i projektach się pojawisz, a w jakich nie.
* **Pieniądze za każde użycie:** otrzymujesz **od 1000 PLN** za każdym razem, gdy marka wykupuje licencję na Twój wizerunek.
* **Pełna legalność:** umowa chroni twój wizerunek i odpowiada przepisom prawa.

Zbieram pierwszą grupę chętnych przed oficjalnym startem. Jeśli brzmi to dla ciebie ciekawie, napisz do mnie w wiadomości prywatnej. Opowiem szczegóły i pomogę przejść przez rejestrację.

* Join a fun, supportive team

**How to Apply:** Comment your Instagram URL + TikTok URL, and we’ll reach out for a quick 10-minute interview if you’re a good fit!
